mechanism: west test owns the whole outer branch, east is an ELSEIF; if both x-coupling flags true on one domain, I=Iend stays in the west arm, fails its I=Ibeg test, and never applies the east prescribed-value term to tmp4 (tridiagonal RHS).
neutralizer: gated by COUPLING compile + DISPERSION runtime, but both-sides-active case not neutralized; no later clamp restores omitted east term

mechanism: single IF advances the spectrum pair by only one record even if TIME crossed several record times → interpolation weights extrapolate until later steps catch up. Hot start or timestep > spectra-record interval reaches this.
neutralizer: small timesteps / EOF-hold avoid it but neither is an enforced bracket guard; no catch-up loop, no weight clamp

mechanism: SEDIMENT_ADVECTION_DIFFUSION runs once per each of 3 RK stages but adds full physical DT to the averaging clock and sums each call → non-default Morph_interval reached at ~1/3 sim time, treating 3 stage states as full-DT samples; MORPHOLOGICAL_CHANGE consumes resulting P_ave/D_ave once per step.
neutralizer: default Morph_interval=SMALL resets every stage (neutralized); explicitly-configured larger interval is real
